name: @portaless/plugin-sdk
description: MIT-licensed public surface for third-party Portaless plugin authors: the capability catalog, manifest validation, and the typed sandbox contract. Self-contained — no AGPL code is imported.
author: Gerardo Loyola

scripts.verify:license: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8")); if(p.license!=="MIT") process.exit(1); if(!fs.readFileSync("LICENSE","utf8").includes("MIT License")) process.exit(1); console.log("[verify:license] MIT + LICENSE OK");'
